text: 商务部公布2027年食糖、羊毛、毛条进口关税配额实施细则。2027年食糖进口关税配额总量为194.5万吨，其中70%为国营贸易关税配额。2027年羊毛进口关税配额总量为28.7万吨，毛条进口关税配额总量为8万吨。（商务部）
text_en: The Ministry of Commerce published the implementation rules for the 2027 import tariff quotas for sugar, wool, and wool tops. The total 2027 sugar import tariff quota is 1.945 million tons, of which 70% is the state trading tariff quota. The total 2027 wool import tariff quota is 287,000 tons, and the total wool tops import tariff quota is 80,000 tons. (Ministry of Commerce)
